main_body: wooden pulpit lectern with side steps
top_band: light tan rim band on rows 13-14 (2 rows) with medium brown trim on 15-16, matching the 'rim only: top 2' failure in the guide
evidence: Reading down a column on the main pulpit body (outside the tiny book): row 12 is dark outline, rows 13-14 are 2 rows of light tan, row 15 is 1 row of mid-brown, row 16 is darker brown cornice trim, row 17 is eave shadow, and rows 18-45 are the tall vertical front face and base. The 2px light band on rows 13-14 (and the 2px cream step tops on the stairs) is a thin rim/molding rather than a foreshortened 3/4 horizontal surface, identical to 'BAD rim only: top 2' in the guide. Furthermore, the open book on top is sitting on the back line of the rim instead of in the middle of a top surface.

style.evidence: While outlines use dark brown material tones and the palette has several browns and reds, the surfaces are very geometric and lack organic pixel texture: the red banner is a large flat fill with a straight 1px highlight, and the stair sides are large uniform brown blocks with only two tiny dark dots per step, looking much flatter and more mechanical than the richly textured wood and stone of the Beodeul references.
